ex.en: I sprained my finger while playing volleyball.
ex.zh: 我打排球時扭傷了手指。

ex.en: Tom and Mary are playing beach volleyball.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗在打沙灘排球。

ex.en: I know Tom is a good volleyball player.
ex.zh: 我知道湯姆是很厲害的排球選手。

volatile.zh: （市場、價格）不穩定的、波動大的

ex.en: The stock market has been very volatile this year.
ex.zh: 今年股市波動很大。

ex.en: Oil prices remain volatile.
ex.zh: 油價仍然波動劇烈。

volatile.zh: （情緒、局勢）易變的、一觸即發的

ex.en: He has a volatile temper.
ex.zh: 他脾氣很火爆。

ex.en: The situation remains volatile.
ex.zh: 情勢依然一觸即發。

ex.en: Gasoline is a volatile liquid.
ex.zh: 汽油是揮發性液體。

ex.en: Store volatile chemicals in a cool place.
ex.zh: 揮發性化學品要存放在陰涼處。

ex.en: He vowed to give up smoking.
ex.zh: 他發誓要戒菸。

ex.en: I vowed that I would never speak to her again.
ex.zh: 我發誓再也不跟她說話了。

ex.en: Tom and Mary vowed they'd never do it.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗發誓絕不會那樣做。

ex.en: Next month is their 50th anniversary, and they're planning on renewing their vows.
ex.zh: 下個月是他們結婚五十週年，他們打算重新宣讀結婚誓言。

ex.en: They exchanged vows in a small church.
ex.zh: 他們在一間小教堂裡交換誓言。

void.zh: 無效的、作廢的（null and void）

ex.en: This contract is null and void.
ex.zh: 這份合約無效。

ex.en: The ticket is void if it has been altered.
ex.zh: 票券若經塗改即作廢。

ex.en: Her words were wholly void of meaning.
ex.zh: 她的話毫無意義。

ex.en: The room was void of any decoration.
ex.zh: 房間裡沒有任何裝飾。

ex.en: His death left a void in her life.
ex.zh: 他的過世在她生命中留下了空缺。

ex.en: Nobody could fill the void after she left the team.
ex.zh: 她離開團隊後，沒有人能填補那個空缺。

void.zh: 使無效、作廢（交易、保固等）

ex.en: The cashier voided the transaction.
ex.zh: 收銀員把這筆交易作廢了。

ex.en: Opening the case will void the warranty.
ex.zh: 打開外殼會使保固失效。

ex.en: My father always speaks in a very loud voice.
ex.zh: 我父親說話總是很大聲。

ex.en: I heard the children's happy voices.
ex.zh: 我聽到孩子們開心的聲音。

ex.en: To my surprise, he had a beautiful voice.
ex.zh: 沒想到他的歌聲那麼好聽。

ex.en: Several staff members voiced concerns about the plan.
ex.zh: 幾位員工對這個計畫表達了疑慮。

ex.en: Customers can voice their opinions online.
ex.zh: 顧客可以在網路上表達意見。

ex.en: Every employee should have a voice in this decision.
ex.zh: 每位員工對這個決定都應該有發言權。

ex.en: The survey gives customers a voice.
ex.zh: 這份調查讓顧客有表達意見的管道。

ex.en: Could you turn the volume down?
ex.zh: 你可以把音量調低一點嗎？

ex.en: Please lower the volume of the music!
ex.zh: 請把音樂的音量調小！

ex.en: Don't turn up the volume of TV anymore.
ex.zh: 電視不要再調大聲了。

ex.en: The dictionary comes in two volumes.
ex.zh: 那本字典分成兩冊。

ex.en: This library has more than 50,000 volumes.
ex.zh: 這座圖書館有超過五萬冊藏書。

ex.en: The volume of sales has increased this year.
ex.zh: 今年的銷售量增加了。

ex.en: We handle a large volume of orders every day.
ex.zh: 我們每天處理大量訂單。

ex.en: Voters will choose a new mayor next month.
ex.zh: 選民下個月將選出新市長。

ex.en: Young voters care a lot about housing prices.
ex.zh: 年輕選民很在意房價。

ex.en: The babies are taken care of by volunteers.
ex.zh: 這些嬰兒由志工照顧。

ex.en: We need more volunteers for the event.
ex.zh: 這次活動我們需要更多志工。

ex.en: Tom was the first person to volunteer.
ex.zh: 湯姆是第一個自願的人。

ex.en: She volunteered to organize the party.
ex.zh: 她自願負責籌辦派對。

ex.en: He volunteers at the hospital on weekends.
ex.zh: 他週末在醫院當志工。

ex.en: She can only go to the company to do voluntary work on Sundays.
ex.zh: 她只有星期天能去公司做義務工作。

ex.en: Attendance at the training is voluntary.
ex.zh: 這次培訓是自由參加的。

ex.en: The company offered voluntary retirement to older staff.
ex.zh: 公司提供年長員工自願退休方案。

ex.en: You need a large vocabulary to read that book.
ex.zh: 你需要有很大的字彙量才能讀那本書。

ex.en: I use flash cards to study my German vocabulary.
ex.zh: 我用字卡背德文單字。

ex.en: She has a rich vocabulary of English words.
ex.zh: 她的英文字彙量很豐富。

ex.en: She left the company of her own volition.
ex.zh: 她是自願離開公司的。

ex.en: Nobody forced him; he acted of his own volition.
ex.zh: 沒有人逼他，他是出於自己的意願。

ex.en: French has many more vowels than Japanese.
ex.zh: 法語的母音比日語多得多。

ex.en: Are there any languages with no vowels?
ex.zh: 有沒有哪種語言是沒有母音的？

ex.en: English has five vowel letters: a, e, i, o and u.
ex.zh: 英文有五個母音字母：a、e、i、o、u。

ex.en: Can I have a discount voucher?
ex.zh: 可以給我一張折價券嗎？

ex.en: Can we get a voucher?
ex.zh: 可以給我們一張抵用券嗎？

ex.en: Investors are worried about market volatility.
ex.zh: 投資人擔心市場波動。

ex.en: The volatility of oil prices affects many industries.
ex.zh: 油價波動影響許多產業。

ex.en: There are many active volcanoes in Japan.
ex.zh: 日本有很多活火山。

ex.en: The volcano erupted suddenly, killing many people.
ex.zh: 火山突然爆發，造成許多人死亡。

ex.en: The volcano has erupted twice this year.
ex.zh: 這座火山今年已經爆發了兩次。

ex.en: For this test, I bought a voltage tester.
ex.zh: 為了這次測試，我買了一支電壓測試器。

ex.en: The device operates at a low voltage.
ex.zh: 這台裝置以低電壓運作。

ex.en: Mary went on a voyage around the world.
ex.zh: 瑪麗展開了環遊世界的航程。

ex.en: Food supplies were carefully counted before the long voyage.
ex.zh: 長途航行前，船員仔細清點了食物存量。

ex.en: Strange to say, no one voted for the candidate.
ex.zh: 說也奇怪，沒有人投票給那位候選人。

ex.en: She voted for Mr Nishioka irrespective of party lines.
ex.zh: 她不論黨派把票投給了西岡先生。

ex.en: The Socialist Party only got 18% of the votes.
ex.zh: 社會黨只拿到 18% 的選票。

ex.en: The bill passed by a small majority of 10 votes.
ex.zh: 法案以十票的些微差距通過。

ex.en: I left a voicemail for her this morning.
ex.zh: 我今天早上在她的語音信箱留了言。

ex.en: Your call has been forwarded to voicemail.
ex.zh: 您的電話已轉入語音信箱。
